title: oven-roasted uruguayan beetroot stir-fry
description: a fermented, crunchy, and delicious uruguayan dish featuring cooked beetroot and stir-fry, perfect for a lazy sunday. this recipe is a twist on traditional uruguayan cuisine, adapted for a flexitarian diet.
instructions: wrap the beetroot in foil and roast for 30 minutes, or until tender.
heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
add the chopped red onion and cook for 5 minutes, or until softened.
add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
stir in the uruguayan chimichurri sauce and season with sea salt and black pepper.
add the roasted beetroot to the skillet and stir to combine.
cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the beetroot is well coated with the sauce.
serve the beetroot mixture over cooked quinoa, if desired.
garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
